description: Mock more than 200 organization devices across full pages with no Link header plus a final short page; assert all devices and advancing after parameters.
Mock a usable Link next cursor and assert the next request follows it and returns the combined result.
For a full page whose final device has no usable id, assert the client rejects and does not issue another request.
Return a repeated/non-advancing cursor or last id and assert the client rejects after a bounded number of calls rather than looping or succeeding partially.
